The '''Kingdom of Barseg''' was an interstellar empire that ruled a number of worlds in the [[Allied Tion sector/Legends|Allied Tion sector]] including the capital [[Barseg]] and [[Lianna/Legends|Lianna]]. One of the [[Three Allied Kingdoms]], it was absorbed by the [[Kingdom of Cron]] during the [[Xer's Campaigns|conquests]] of the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]]-[[King/Legends|king]] [[Xer VIII]].

After the [[Xim's empire|empire]] collapsed following the defeat of Xer's son [[Xim/Legends|Xim the Despot]] at the [[Third Battle of Vontor]], the Kingdom of Barseg was restored as one of the successor states of Xim's empire, and survived inclusion into the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in [[23,900 BBY]].

The Lianna provinces of [[Caldara]] and [[Berene]] led the last great independence war on Lianna against Barseg, which resulted in the annihilation of both provinces. The plight of Lianna was ignored by the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] until the Senate itself took control of Lianna from Barseg in [[300 BBY/Legends|300 BBY]]. While a member of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the fate of the kingdom after 300 BBY is currently unknown.
